project_goal: Build a local-first Chrome/Edge extension where a job seeker maintains one structured profile and can safely preview and fill matching fields on recruitment websites without automatic submission.

features.title: Create resumable engineering harness
acceptance: A future agent can recover the product goal, current status, constraints, verification commands, and next action without chat history.
The environment baseline identifies an available Node.js toolchain and installed Chromium browser.
verification: Confirm AGENTS.md, progress.md, and init.ps1 exist.
Record node, npm, Git, Chrome, and Edge availability in progress.md.
features.notes: Initialized on 2026-08-03 from an empty, non-Git directory. Evidence is recorded in progress.md.

features.title: Establish Manifest V3 build and test foundation
acceptance: npm run build produces a loadable dist/ with manifest.json, options.html, sidepanel.html, background.js, and content.js.
The initial MVP manifest requested only storage, activeTab, scripting, and sidePanel permissions; later F037 may expand this baseline through its own explicit acceptance and privacy review.
Type checking and a smoke unit test pass.
features.notes: Use Vite for React pages and esbuild for isolated background/content bundles. Keep the extension free of remote runtime code.

features.title: Define profile schema and local repository
acceptance: The profile schema covers basic information, education, work experience, projects, job preferences, and reusable self-introduction.
Users can add multiple education, work, and project records.
Profile data persists through chrome.storage.local with a browser-preview fallback and supports schema-version migration.
Completion percentage is deterministic and excludes optional empty records.
features.notes: Store blanks rather than fabricated example identities. Attachments are metadata-only in the MVP.

features.title: Build structured profile editor
acceptance: The options page edits all MVP profile sections and supports adding/removing repeatable records.
Saving, unsaved state, validation errors, and last-saved feedback are visible.
A completion indicator explains which required fields remain empty.
Keyboard navigation and field labels are usable without a mouse.
features.notes: Organic visual direction; no fake user data in the UI.

features.title: Implement deterministic field discovery and matching
acceptance: The matcher handles input, textarea, select, radio, and contenteditable controls using labels, ARIA text, placeholder, name, id, and nearby context.
Aliases map common Chinese and English recruitment-field names to canonical profile paths.
Every suggestion returns a score, high/medium/low confidence, reasons, and whether confirmation is required.
Ambiguous and sensitive fields are never classified as safe high-confidence fills.
verification: Fixture test covers at least 30 representative field labels.
features.notes: Rule-first matching is the MVP. AI semantic fallback remains out of scope until deterministic accuracy is measured.

features.title: Implement safe page scanning and filling
acceptance: A content script scans the active page only after a user action and returns a preview without changing the form.
Filling supports native controls and dispatches input/change/blur events compatible with controlled web forms.
Only user-selected high/medium-confidence matches are filled.
File inputs, passwords, hidden inputs, CAPTCHAs, and submission controls are excluded.
verification: Fixture assertions confirm no submit click and no excluded-field mutation.
features.notes: Use a stable per-scan element identifier rather than brittle CSS selectors.

features.title: Build side-panel preview and fill workflow
acceptance: The side panel shows profile readiness, page scan status, matched/unmatched counts, and confidence groups.
Users can inspect and deselect each proposed fill before applying changes.
Sensitive and medium-confidence suggestions require explicit selection.
The panel links to profile editing and never exposes a final-submit action.
features.notes: Use a user-triggered injection path with activeTab rather than broad all-sites access.

features.title: Add correction memory and privacy controls
acceptance: A user can override a suggested canonical field and reuse that mapping for the same site and field fingerprint.
Users can export, import, and permanently delete locally stored profile and mapping data.
The product explains local storage, requested permissions, and sensitive-field behavior before first use.
verification: Manual check of first-run disclosure and delete confirmation.
features.notes: Do not add telemetry or cloud sync in the MVP.

features.title: Create representative recruitment-form fixture and end-to-end evidence
acceptance: A local fixture includes ordinary inputs, custom-looking selects, radio choices, dynamic fields, ambiguous labels, a file input, a password trap, and a submit button.
End-to-end tests exercise profile save, preview, selective fill, correction memory, and deletion.
Screenshots show the options page and side panel at desktop extension dimensions.
features.notes: Use installed Chrome/Edge when possible; do not require downloading a second browser.

features.title: Package MVP and write operator documentation
acceptance: README documents setup, development, unpacked installation, use, privacy boundaries, limitations, and troubleshooting.
npm run package creates a distributable zip from a freshly verified build.
All feature statuses and latest verification evidence are current.
verification: Inspect archive contents and confirm no source maps, test fixtures, or personal profile data are included.
features.notes: Chrome Web Store publication is outside the MVP because it requires the user's developer account and privacy-policy decisions.

features.title: Harden field coverage against the Xiaomi internship application form
acceptance: A traceable inventory records the Xiaomi form labels, control types, required state, dynamic sections, and login boundary observed from the supplied real URL.

The profile schema and deterministic matcher cover the reusable Xiaomi fields that are safe and technically fillable, while files, verification, identity-sensitive, and final-submit controls remain confirmation-required or excluded.
An automated non-submitting regression fixture derived from the observed Xiaomi structure verifies scanning, preview, selective fill, custom controls, and no-submit behavior.
A real-page smoke test reaches the supplied URL and records either verified scan/fill evidence or the exact authentication blocker without weakening privacy or browser permissions.
verification: Inspect a current Xiaomi-specific screenshot in artifacts/.
features.notes: Never submit the application. Do not persist site authentication, bypass login, CAPTCHA, SMS, or identity checks.

features.title: Parse an uploaded resume into the existing profile form
acceptance: The existing profile editor has one clearly labelled resume-upload control that accepts PDF and DOCX files, rejects unsupported or oversized files, and parses only after the user's file-selection gesture.
PDF and DOCX text extraction runs entirely in the extension page without network calls; the resume file, raw extracted text, site passwords, and authentication cookies are never persisted.

Deterministic parsing maps evidence-backed basic information, education, internship/work, project, award, language, job-preference, and self-evaluation values directly into the corresponding fields of the existing profile form; it does not create a separate result-confirmation page and does not fabricate missing values.

Import fills empty scalar fields and merges non-duplicate repeatable records while preserving existing non-empty values; the user can review and edit every imported value in the normal profile form before explicitly saving.

The parser covers the reusable fields proven by the current Xiaomi internship application page audit, while identity documents, verification codes, passwords, file controls, privacy consent, CAPTCHA, and final submission remain excluded.
A realistic Chinese campus-recruitment resume fixture proves multi-section extraction and direct form population, and browser evidence shows the populated existing form plus a concise import summary.
verification: Inspect artifacts/resume-import.png and confirm values appear in the existing profile sections without a separate confirmation page.
features.notes: Local deterministic parsing only. PDF/DOCX are the initial supported formats; scanned/image-only resumes must return an actionable error rather than invent data. Existing profile values are protected from silent overwrite.

features.title: Harden internship and project parsing against real local resumes
acceptance: A privacy-safe audit covers all five resume-like PDF files currently present in the user's Downloads folder, identifying samples only by short content digest and never copying source files, filenames, raw text, or personal values into the repository.

For every audited sample whose extracted text visibly contains internship/work or project section evidence, the parser returns the manually verified number of corresponding records instead of silently returning an empty array.

Section recognition tolerates PDF layout artifacts observed in the real samples, including spaced headings, combined work/internship headings, headings with inline content, organization/title/date split across lines, and entries without a date range on their first line.

Work and project records retain evidence-backed organization/name, role, date, and description values without leaking neighboring education, skill, award, or self-evaluation text across section boundaries.
Anonymized structural fixtures derived from each distinct failing layout reproduce the defect and pass after the fix; no real personal information is committed to tests or artifacts.
The existing local-only, no-fabrication, conflict-preserving, no-submit, and explicit-save safety boundaries remain unchanged.
verification: Run the privacy-safe local resume audit against the five digest-identified Downloads samples and record expected versus actual work/project counts.
features.notes: Do not add or copy the user's resumes into the repository. Convert only layout patterns into synthetic fixtures. Keep deterministic parsing as the source of truth.

features.title: Verify field-level resume completeness and profile-form placement
acceptance: A visual field inventory is defined for all five digest-identified local resumes, covering every clearly present field supported by the profile schema rather than only counting work and project records.

Every expected work and project record is checked field by field for evidence-backed organization/name, role when present, start/end dates when present at month precision, and non-empty description without neighboring-section leakage.

Basic, education, award, language, skill, work, and project values that are both visibly present and supported by the current schema are measured for coverage; unsupported or genuinely absent values are not fabricated.

The actual resume-upload UI places parsed values into the corresponding labelled controls for every repeatable work and project record, preserves record order, remains unsaved until explicit save, and persists no source file or raw text.
Anonymized structural tests reproduce every field-level omission or contamination found by the real audit, including wrapped date ranges and standalone role lines.

Privacy and automation constraints remain unchanged: local processing by default, no identity-number persistence, no recruitment-site password/Cookie storage, no verification bypass, and no final submission.
verification: Run a privacy-safe five-PDF field coverage audit and record expected, parsed, merged, and UI-placed field coverage by digest.
Inspect a current artifacts/resume-import.png that shows repeatable work/project fields populated in the existing editor.
features.notes: Counts alone are insufficient. Do not mark done until field values and their destination controls are verified. Keep real resume text and personal values out of committed tests and audit artifacts.

features.title: Establish real-page acceptance for Agent Reach and OpenCLI control
acceptance: A source-bound validation document separates evidence from the live Xiaomi public schema, an authenticated real-tab read-only scan, a user-confirmed real-tab selective fill, and the Xiaomi-derived local regression; local fixtures never count as proof that the live page worked.

An executable preflight reports the installed OpenCLI version, daemon availability, Browser Bridge connection, exact target URL eligibility, and this extension's permission boundary without starting a daemon, installing software, reading cookies, reading page values, or mutating a browser profile.

The agent command contract exposes only status, scan, preview, and selective fill; it exposes no submit, file-upload, password, verification-code, CAPTCHA, cookie, identity-number, or arbitrary-selector/value command.

Every agent session is created by an explicit side-panel user gesture, is bound to one tab and HTTPS origin, expires automatically, and rejects missing, stale, wrong-tab, wrong-origin, replayed, or malformed capabilities.

Scan and preview never mutate the page or return existing webpage values. Fill accepts only opaque suggestion IDs from the latest scan, revalidates the live field mapping, requires action-time user confirmation, and keeps sensitive or medium-confidence suggestions unselected until separately approved.

Live Xiaomi completion evidence includes the exact URL and timestamp, Bridge-connected and bound-tab proof, scan/preview counts, user-confirmed selected-fill outcomes, and proof that no final-submit control or application-submission request was invoked; no personal values, cookies, or authentication artifacts are committed.

The extension remains local-first and retains its existing required permissions; any localhost access needed by an optional companion must use runtime-requested optional permission and must not add cookies, debugger, broad host access, or automatic submission capability.
verification: Run the documented OpenCLI bound-tab real-page smoke on the authenticated Xiaomi URL and record non-submitting evidence in progress.md.
Inspect artifacts/xiaomi-agent-bridge.png and confirm it shows preview/fill results without a final-submit action.
features.notes: OpenCLI is an optional companion and must stay separate from the least-privilege extension. The activeTab repair is implemented and validated locally; completion is blocked only on a post-reload physical toolbar click, authenticated real-page scan, and separately confirmed selective fill. Do not mark done from a public schema or local fixture.

features.title: Compare the local profile with current page values without leaking them
acceptance: A user-triggered scan classifies every mapped readable control as empty, equal, conflicting, or unreadable using deterministic field-aware normalization.
The scan result, agent protocol, logs, tests, and screenshots expose the comparison class but never return, persist, or record the current webpage value.
Only empty, high-confidence, non-sensitive controls are selected by default; equal controls are skipped and conflicting controls remain unselected until explicit confirmation.
Filling rechecks the live control immediately before writing and refuses a stale or newly conflicting value unless the exact conflict was explicitly approved for that scan.
Password, verification, CAPTCHA, identity-number, privacy-consent, file, and submit controls remain excluded.
verification: Inspect artifacts/page-comparison.png and confirm it shows statuses and counts without raw current webpage values or a submit action.
features.notes: Completed 2026-08-05. Comparison is derived inside the content script; only status and an opaque, scan-bound conflict token cross the boundary. Targeted tests, full validation, full E2E, and artifacts/page-comparison.png passed.

features.title: Build a traceable all-source field coverage matrix
acceptance: A durable matrix records the union of evidence-backed fields from the structured profile, resume parser, and audited recruitment pages, with source, sensitivity, control kind, normalization, and support state.
The profile schema and editor add only fields proven by a resume or audited page; missing facts are never fabricated and migrations preserve existing local data.
Every supported field has aliases, a destination profile path, comparison normalization, and deterministic tests; unsupported fields have an explicit reason.
verification: npm test -- --run src/domain src/matching src/options src/resume
Review docs/field-coverage-matrix.md for source and safety completeness.
features.notes: In progress 2026-08-05. All means all evidence-backed and permitted fields, not credentials, verification, identity numbers, privacy consent, or final submission. The matrix must include real-page structural evidence for repeatable groups before F017 may click any add control.

features.title: Create missing repeatable form records before filling
acceptance: The assistant compares profile record counts with visible education, work, project, award, language, and work-sample groups.
It can invoke only section-local, high-confidence add controls to create missing rows, with a strict count bound and a rescan after each structural change.
It never deletes, reorders, or silently overwrites existing webpage records, and it stops when the page structure or add-control identity changes.
verification: Inspect artifacts/repeatable-records.png and confirm no submit or delete control was used.
features.notes: Implement one section type per verified increment; do not use arbitrary text-based button clicking.

features.title: Harden complex recruitment controls and verified writes
acceptance: Deterministic adapters cover audited date ranges, searchable and cascading selects, radio groups, multi-selects, and rich-text fields.
Every write dispatches framework-compatible events and is verified by rereading the control state without exposing its raw value outside the page context.
Unsupported or ambiguous controls fail closed with a reason and never fall back to arbitrary selector/value execution.
verification: Inspect current complex-control screenshots in artifacts/.
features.notes: Completed on 2026-08-06. A clean-room behavior audit of jackwener/OpenCLI 1.8.6 informed stable element references, scroll/focus preparation, bounded waits, exact option selection, and write-after-read verification. The activeTab content-script driver now covers exact searchable/cascading selects, native multi-selects, radios, rich text, and structurally indexed composite date ranges, with bounded retry and fail-closed verification. A live Xiaomi tab supplied read-only structural evidence only; all mutations ran against anonymous fixtures. Validation passed 24 files / 218 tests, browser E2E passed 19/19, the Xiaomi contract audit retained 9 groups / 34 visible fields / zero submission, and artifacts/complex-controls.png was visually inspected. Permissions remain exactly activeTab, scripting, sidePanel, and storage; no daemon/CDP transport, debugger, cookies, <all_urls>, filesystem-path upload, arbitrary evaluation, CAPTCHA/identity handling, or submission action was added.

features.title: Prove a safe architecture for resume PDF attachment
acceptance: A threat model and executable prototype compare an extension-memory File flow with a narrowly scoped OpenCLI/DevTools attachment token without adding broad permissions to the assistant.
The chosen path requires a user-selected PDF, validates MIME type, size, and digest, retains no arbitrary filesystem path, and keeps bytes out of logs and persistent extension storage.
The prototype proves whether the target site uploads immediately on file selection so the confirmation point is placed before any network transmission.
verification: Run a local file-input fixture with network observation and no final submission.
features.notes: User-prioritized on 2026-08-05. F018 is not a technical dependency because attachment discovery and File transfer are isolated from complex value-control adapters. Do not add a generic upload command. If the in-page File flow is rejected by Chrome or the ATS, use an opaque, single-use, page-bound OpenCLI token rather than an agent-supplied path.

features.title: Implement user-confirmed resume PDF attachment
acceptance: The user selects one PDF for the current session and sees filename, size, digest prefix, destination site, and matched resume control before approval.
One action-time confirmation authorizes one page-bound attachment attempt for one exact file digest and expires within one minute.
Only a high-confidence resume attachment control can receive the file; identity, verification, arbitrary file inputs, privacy consent, and submit controls remain unavailable.
Success and failure are verified without persisting the file, raw path, bytes, authentication data, or personal values.
verification: Inspect artifacts/resume-attachment.png and confirm it contains no path, resume contents, identity data, or submit action.
features.notes: Attaching may transmit the PDF immediately; it is always confirmation-required and never part of default-safe fill.

features.title: Turn real-page failures into privacy-safe regression improvements
acceptance: Each run emits only structural counters and failure codes for matching, comparison, add-row, control, permission, attachment, and navigation failures.
A documented workflow converts a real failure into an anonymized local fixture, one scoped repair, targeted tests, full validation, and a progress handoff.
No raw webpage value, profile value, resume text, file path, cookie, token, or authentication artifact enters fixtures, logs, screenshots, or commits.
verification: Exercise at least one anonymized regression for every supported failure class.
Review progress.md handoffs for exact evidence and next actions.
features.notes: Deterministic corrections and site fingerprints remain the source of truth; semantic matching stays a separately evaluated fallback.

features.title: Complete multi-site non-submitting acceptance and package the workflow
acceptance: At least three structurally different recruitment systems complete scan, redacted comparison, selected fill, repeatable-row, and supported attachment gates with exact evidence.
Every real-site run proves zero final-submit clicks and zero application-submission requests, with sensitive and conflicting fields left unchanged unless individually approved.
README, privacy documentation, operator recovery steps, screenshots, feature statuses, and the distributable package reflect the final behavior.
verification: Run documented non-submitting real-page gates for each accepted site.
Inspect current redacted screenshots and verify the archive contains no personal or authentication data.
features.notes: Real-site evidence requires the user's logged-in browser and action-time confirmations. Never weaken the no-submit boundary to complete acceptance.

features.title: Expand resume extraction with the current local resume corpus
acceptance: A privacy-safe inventory covers every resume-like PDF/DOCX currently found in the user's Downloads folder, identifies real samples only by short content digest in repository evidence, and never commits filenames, source files, raw text, or personal values.

Every newly discovered layout is visually reviewed and audited field by field against the supported profile schema, including basic information, education, work/internships, projects, awards, languages, skills, and descriptions.

Each deterministic extraction or parsing failure is reproduced with an anonymized synthetic fixture before the scoped fix; existing non-empty profile values remain protected and missing facts are never fabricated.

A local end-to-end regression proves that imported structured records can create required repeatable rows and fill the corresponding recruitment-form controls without file attachment or final submission.
verification: Run a local digest-only resume audit and record expected versus parsed supported-field coverage for every newly discovered layout.
npm test -- --run src/resume src/options src/content src/matching
Inspect a current screenshot in artifacts/ and confirm it contains only synthetic data and no submit action.
features.notes: User-prioritized after F017. Real resume names, text, personal values, and files stay outside Git; only anonymized structural regressions and aggregate digest evidence may be committed.

features.title: Publish a Chinese operator guide and installable Codex skill
acceptance: The public README gives Chinese end users a release-download path, unpacked Chrome/Edge loading steps, first-use workflow, activeTab recovery, privacy boundaries, and contributor commands.

A repository-local Codex skill can guide safe installation, build, page authorization, resume import, preview, selective filling, and troubleshooting without exposing a final-submit, verification-bypass, credential, cookie, or arbitrary-file action.
One documented command installs the skill into the user's Codex skills directory, and deterministic validation proves the packaged skill metadata and copied contents are valid.
The extension archive and skill archive are freshly generated, audited for personal/authentication data, and published with the source changes on GitHub.
verification: Run the skill creator quick validator against the repository skill.
Run the skill installer in an isolated destination and compare required files.
Inspect both archives and run a publish-scope privacy scan before pushing.
features.notes: User-requested distribution milestone. Generated archives remain ignored by Git and are uploaded as release assets; source skill files are committed.

features.title: Complete real-machine recruitment-site resume attachment acceptance
acceptance: The unpacked extension is refreshed in the user's ordinary Chrome or Edge profile, the authenticated recruitment tab receives activeTab from a physical toolbar click, and the side panel discovers exactly one high-confidence resume PDF control on the expected HTTPS Origin.

Before confirmation, a 30-second observation proves no attachment request and the target input remains empty; the UI shows only the exact user-selected PDF filename, size, digest prefix, HTTPS Origin, and matched control.

One explicit confirmation produces at most one attachment attempt, the recruitment page visibly accepts the expected filename or reports an actionable failure, and identity, verification, other file inputs, and final submission remain untouched.

Evidence records only structural counts, status codes, timestamps, Origin, and a short file digest; it never records a real filename, path, resume contents, page values, cookies, tokens, or screenshots containing personal data.
verification: Run npm run validate and npm run test:e2e before loading dist/.
Physically click the extension icon on the exact authenticated HTTPS recruitment page, rescan, and compare the displayed Origin and matched control.
Observe the page and browser network activity for 30 seconds before confirmation, then confirm exactly one chosen PDF and verify at most one attachment request with zero final-submit requests.
Record a privacy-redacted pass/fail handoff in progress.md; do not capture a screenshot unless the page and filename are anonymized.
features.notes: Blocked on the user's action-time choice of an exact local PDF and authenticated HTTPS recruitment page. Because many ATS products upload immediately on file-input change, no live transfer may be inferred from earlier resume audits or performed without this confirmation.

features.title: Build a privacy-safe fill-quality evaluation harness
acceptance: A versioned synthetic browser suite measures field-match precision and recall, selected-fill exactness, repeatable-record coverage, attachment targeting, and critical safety invariants against explicit ground truth rather than an LLM opinion.

The evaluation artifact contains only synthetic labels, canonical profile paths, confidence/reason codes, boolean outcomes, aggregate metrics, and safety counters; it contains no resume text, personal value, raw page value, HTML, screenshot, path, cookie, token, or authentication data.

A development-only judge adapter reads credentials from ignored local environment files, refuses non-HTTPS endpoints and redirects, never exposes the API key, sends only the sanitized artifact, requires structured JSON, and records a sanitized advisory result separately from product code.

Promotion gates keep deterministic rules as the source of truth: critical-safety pass rate must remain 100%, precision cannot regress, recall gains require fixture evidence, and model suggestions remain candidates until a regression test and rollback path exist.
verification: Inspect artifacts/fill-quality-observation.json and artifacts/fill-quality-report.json for synthetic-only content.
features.notes: User-prioritized on 2026-08-05. DeepSeek is a shadow reviewer, never the scoring oracle or runtime matcher. The extension remains network-free; only an explicit development command may call the configured evaluator.

features.title: Calibrate DeepSeek V4 Flash as a shadow fill-quality reviewer
acceptance: The configured model is called only through a verified HTTPS endpoint using temperature zero and a bounded structured-output prompt over the synthetic evaluation artifact.
Calibration examples include known-good behavior, an incorrect field match, a missed fill, and a critical unsafe mutation; judge detection is scored independently from product accuracy.
At least three repeated judgments are compared when results disagree, and the report separates deterministic failures, judge-only hypotheses, latency, token usage, and malformed-response failures.
No program mutation is promoted directly from one judge response, and a failed or unavailable judge leaves the deterministic baseline usable.
verification: Verify the endpoint is HTTPS and the returned model identifier matches the expected configured model family.
Inspect the sanitized judge report and calibration confusion matrix without printing the API key or request payload values.
Repeat only disagreement cases up to the documented budget and stop when the action would not change.
features.notes: Completed on 2026-08-05 against Boyue's certificate-verified HTTPS hostname. The synthetic-only judgment returned deepseek-v4-flash, matched the configured model family, classified all four calibration cases correctly, produced no findings against the passing deterministic baseline, and used 3,509 tokens in 35,859 ms. No repeat was needed because deterministic and judge results agreed.

features.title: Promote one evidence-backed fill-quality improvement
acceptance: The highest-impact reproducible failure is reduced to one anonymized fixture and one narrowly scoped deterministic matcher, parser, control-adapter, or workflow candidate change.
Baseline-versus-candidate evaluation shows the target failure fixed, no precision or critical-safety regression, and an explicit rollback commit or patch.
DeepSeek feedback is cited only as diagnostic evidence; exact expected paths, values, DOM outcomes, and safety counters decide promotion.
The accepted or rejected candidate is versioned in progress.md with evidence, cost, risk, Human Gate status, and the next evaluation question.
verification: Run the targeted regression for the changed subsystem.
features.notes: Do not change runtime behavior when the judge only proposes stylistic improvements or cannot identify a deterministic counterexample. One evaluated candidate per iteration keeps rollback cheap.

features.title: Audit resume extraction completeness and correctness with DeepSeek
acceptance: A development-only browser audit reads the current local PDF/DOCX resume corpus, identifies samples only by short digest, and compares numbered redacted source lines with the deterministic parsed profile without changing the extension runtime.

Direct identifiers including names, phone numbers, email addresses, identity numbers, URLs, street addresses, filenames, and filesystem paths are removed before any HTTPS request; the API key, cookies, authentication data, raw files, and unredacted resume text are never persisted or logged.

DeepSeek classifies schema-supported facts as correct, missing, incorrect, ambiguous, or source-absent using allowed canonical path patterns and source line ids; schema gaps and parser gaps are reported separately, and model output remains advisory.

Known complete, missed-field, wrong-field, and unsupported-field calibration cases are scored independently; a model mismatch, incomplete calibration, malformed output, redirect, HTTP endpoint, or privacy audit fails closed.

The ignored report records per-section candidate coverage and bounded sanitized findings so the highest-value reproducible parser gap can become one anonymous regression instead of an untraceable model-driven rewrite.
verification: Inspect ignored resume-completeness artifacts for digest-only sample identity, redacted source evidence, bounded output, and absence of direct identifiers or credentials.
features.notes: Completed on 2026-08-05. The 11-sample digest allowlist produced 668 redacted source lines and 370 web-fillable parsed facts with no parser warnings. Boyue matched deepseek-v4-flash and scored every calibration 4/4, but real-corpus finding counts changed materially after privacy/prompt clarification (105 to 126 supported defects), proving that model estimates are candidate discovery rather than ground truth. Per-sample checkpoints and targeted reruns make later iterations resumable and bounded.

features.title: Promote one evidence-backed maximum-coverage resume extraction improvement
acceptance: The highest-impact DeepSeek candidate is verified against local source structure and reduced to one synthetic fixture containing no personal values.

A narrowly scoped deterministic parser or schema change increases supported-field recall on the fixture and affected digest while preserving no-fabrication, conflict-preserving merge behavior, and neighboring-section isolation.

Before-versus-after evidence reports populated paths, record counts, supported missing fields, incorrect fields, schema gaps, and webpage-fill coverage without treating a larger raw field count as correctness by itself.
The candidate is accepted only when targeted tests, the full resume suite, fill-quality gates, validation, and browser E2E pass; otherwise it is rejected with a recorded reason and rollback path.
features.notes: Completed on 2026-08-05. A real date-first current education row had `至今` prefixed to the school and repeated the school inside the major. The current-marker-aware school extractor plus an anonymous regression corrected both values while preserving an empty end date, all 370 corpus facts, perfect fill-quality gates, 198 unit tests, and 17 browser E2E tests. Targeted DeepSeek findings for the affected digest dropped from 9 to 4 and the two corrected paths disappeared, but remaining policy-violating model findings were not promoted.

features.title: Prevent contact headers and activities from leaking into structured records
acceptance: A contact header containing email, phone, portfolio URL, and social account may create an evidenced link but never becomes a work-sample description or another narrative field.
A dated team, club, or extracurricular role outside an award section does not become an award or education record, while explicit competition results remain extractable as awards.
Anonymous fixtures reproduce each accepted source-boundary defect and affected real digests show fewer incorrect paths without losing valid links, awards, education, or projects.
DeepSeek is used only for targeted candidate review; exact parser outputs and section evidence determine acceptance.
features.notes: Next recommended feature. Start with the contact-header-to-workSamples.description leak because it is source-visible, privacy-relevant, and has a narrow rollback surface.

features.title: Recover substantive project titles and wrapped project content
acceptance: Generic labels such as paper/project ordinals are replaced by an explicitly evidenced substantive title when present on the same source record.
Wrapped title, description, outcome, role, and date lines stay on the correct project without creating body-text projects or crossing section boundaries.
Anonymous fixtures cover bullet-only projects, English wrapped titles, labelled paper titles, and page-number noise; no publication year is invented as a project duration.
Affected digest comparisons improve exact record fields without reducing project count or neighboring-section isolation.
verification: Run targeted DeepSeek review only for affected digests.
features.notes: Prioritize only after F031 or when project correctness is the next user-visible blocker; model findings must be reduced to exact source structures first.

features.title: Associate education metrics and records without award leakage
acceptance: GPA and ranking lines attach to the evidenced education record rather than a later admission or award line.
Award prose mentioning a university, GPA, or rank cannot create a new education record without a school-and-date education header.
Current and future education rows retain explicit degree, major, dates, GPA, and ranking without borrowing unsupported values across records.
Affected digest and anonymous fixture comparisons show no record-count regression or fabricated end date.
verification: Run targeted DeepSeek review only for affected digests.
features.notes: Use the visibly evidenced GPA/ranking candidates from the digest corpus, but do not infer a degree from `推免` or move metrics without record-local evidence.

features.title: Persist one reusable PDF resume locally
acceptance: Selecting a valid PDF in the profile editor stores one reusable copy in extension-local IndexedDB with filename, MIME type, byte length, SHA-256 digest, and save time; selecting a new PDF replaces the previous copy.

The saved PDF is restored after the options page or side panel is reopened, and can be attached to a uniquely identified recruitment-page resume control without reopening the operating-system file picker.

Persistence does not weaken attachment safety: the destination origin and control remain visible, every site attachment still requires a fresh user confirmation, authorizations remain single-use and time-limited, and final submission is never clicked.
Invalid, oversized, non-PDF, signature-mismatched, digest-mismatched, or unreadable saved records fail closed; raw bytes, extracted text, filenames, and paths are never sent over the network.
The user can replace or delete the saved PDF, and deleting all local data clears the profile, mappings, and saved PDF; JSON export explicitly excludes PDF bytes.

features.title: Implement verified browser action primitives
acceptance: Typed click, type, select, check, and fill primitives act only on an opaque reference and snapshot from the current pinned session; callers cannot supply CSS/XPath, CDP IDs, arbitrary JavaScript, or an arbitrary page value.

The action schema rejects unknown properties and binds every request to a user-created authorization, the active session, the current snapshot membership, the original opaque reference, an internal semantic fingerprint, a locally recorded profile revision, and an explicitly proven same-Origin boundary.

Profile-backed writes resolve an allowlisted profile path locally after the safety check. Fixed strategies cover text inputs, textarea, native select, radio, checkbox, date/month inputs, and contenteditable while dispatching browser/framework-compatible input, change, keyboard, and blur events.

Every supported write is reread inside the page and returns only typed success/failure, strategy, and attempt count. The old value, requested value, current value, and resume content never enter responses or logs.

A primary strategy may use at most one bounded non-clipboard fallback. A stale reference, changed semantic fingerprint, disabled/read-only control, failed verification, or framework rejection fails closed instead of moving to another control.
Password, CAPTCHA, verification, identity, file, consent, destructive, and final-submit controls are blocked in 100% of ground-truth safety cases.

The fixed anonymous HTTPS/real-Chrome denominator contains 24 supported actions, 8 restricted controls, 8 integrity failures, and 2 typed rejections. Primary verified success is at least 23/24, final verified success is 24/24, both negative sets are 100% fail-closed, and wrong-control writes, third attempts, clipboard calls, cross-Origin actions, final submissions, and forbidden evidence leaks are all zero.

features.title: Add waits, same-Origin navigation, and idempotent workflow control
acceptance: Wait supports bounded state, role/semantic find, option-list, navigation, and DOM-settle conditions with typed timeout errors; it never accepts an arbitrary selector or waits indefinitely.
Async searchable/cascading selects, custom date/month ranges, and component popovers are operated as find-click-wait-refind workflows rather than hidden-value mutation.
Same-Origin multi-step and SPA navigation preserves the pinned session while invalidating stale snapshots; an Origin change pauses and detaches before another action.

Repeating the same requestId never repeats a side effect, including after a service-worker restart. An in-flight request recovered after restart fails closed as uncertain instead of replaying the mutation, and a conflicting payload under the same requestId is rejected.

The fixed anonymous HTTPS/real-Chrome denominator contains 12 successful waits/workflow transitions, 6 bounded timeout or safety failures, and 4 idempotency cases. All 12 positives and all 10 negative/idempotency gates must pass; duplicate side effects, cross-Origin continuation, infinite waits, stale-reference writes, arbitrary selectors, third attempts, final submissions, and forbidden evidence leaks are zero.
